Name: WSilenceW's Diorama Box Room(PIF)
Author: WSilenceW
Description:
增加一个微缩景观盒子风格的房间地图，需要PIF前置mod（Personal Rooms），通过装饰门进入；盒子内的墙纸和地板可以更换，能够放置床。
通过右侧的梯子上到盒子顶部，顶部可以放置装饰。


我的小红书账号：韭菜炖大鹅

==========================================================================

Adds a Diorama Box Room-style map.Requires the PIF (Personal Rooms) mod as a prerequisite.Accessed via a decorative door.The wallpaper and flooring inside the box can be changed., and a bed can be placed inside.
Climb up the ladder on the right to access the roof of the box, which provides an extra space for decorations.
